title: mcp-atlassian tools bypass configured project and space filters
summary: Most identifier-bearing tools omit project or space allowlist checks. Callers can read or mutate resources outside the configured filters wherever the underlying Atlassian credential has access.

severity.rationale: An apparent access boundary fails across MCP read and write tools. Data disclosure and unauthorized changes through shared credentials warrant 72 hours.

exposure: Deployments relying on JIRA_PROJECTS_FILTER or CONFLUENCE_SPACES_FILTER while credentials cover additional resources are exposed. With ALLOW_GLOBAL_CRED_FALLBACK=true, exposure extends to unauthenticated callers using the operator's credentials.

remediation.details: Upgrade mcp-atlassian to 0.24.1 or later and restart its server.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating or containment can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed and running component meets the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.
